title: Mouseion Contingent vs Protectores Divini Lateris
lede:
Mouseion Contingent won 32-20 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4 without destroying a single enemy unit, and dealt 6 damage all battle.

It won on cards: a secondary completed in every round (11 VP) and FORLORN HOPE in every round from the second (6 VP), on top of the flank objectives. The Protectores' four units held the centre from Round 2 but could not reach the flanks.
result_line: Mouseion Contingent win 32-20 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Mouseion Contingent spread nine units across its back rows around the HQ at (7,13): the Heliostat Battery at (3,13), the Ikarus Skirmishers at (4,12) (they began the battle in the air), Argyraspides 2 with the Asklepian Medic at (5,12), the Hephaestian Tripod at (7,14), League Hoplite 2 at (9,12), Argyraspides 1 with Heron of Alexandria at (10,12) and League Hoplite 1 at (11,12). Delphic Apotropaia cast its Omen Dice: 2, 4, 3, 2, 5, 3. Protectores Divini Lateris brought four units for 250 RP: Palatine Custos 1 with the Palatine Protospatharius at (3,2), Palatine Custos 2 at (9,2) and the Palatine Artillerists at (11,2), around its HQ at (7,1). It was nine units against four for three objectives. The Protectores had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (5 to 10).

feed.text: Primaries revealed: FORLORN HOPE for the Mouseion, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Protectores. The Mouseion kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and the Protectores named the centre as its objective; the Protectores kept DEEP REACH. The Mouseion spent 2 CP on Double Time for Argyraspides 1, the Protectores 1 on Scouting Order for Palatine Custos 2; both bought nothing.

An Omen Die of 5 gave every Mouseion unit +1 MOVE. Argyraspides 1 and Heron of Alexandria walked onto the centre at 8,7 and League Hoplite 1 onto the right objective at 13,8. Palatine Custos 1 and the Protospatharius reached 6,6, on the edge of the centre, with the Artillerists at 7,5 and Palatine Custos 2 at 7,4 behind them.
No unit on either side had a legal action, and both passed.

The Mouseion held the centre on OC 13 vs 5 and the right on OC 10 vs 0, 5 VP, and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET paid 3 for the centre. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Protectores 1 for their unit in the centre's area. Pietas: the Protectores +4, to Tier II. 8-1.
For FORLORN HOPE the Protectores named the Asklepian Medic. Secondaries kept: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and ASSASSINATION. Neither side spent CP in the Command Phase.

The Palatine Artillerists stepped onto the centre at 6,7 under Go to Ground (1 CP) and took four Mouseion Overwatch shots, all needing natural 6s, none through. Palatine Custos 2 and then Palatine Custos 1 with the Protospatharius charged Argyraspides 1 and Heron of Alexandria (an Omen Die of 4 gave Mouseion melee +1 HIT). Argyraspides 1 failed its Fall Back test (needed 6, rolled 2) and broke away in disorder to 8,8 for 3 True Damage and a model; its own Go to Ground (1 CP) turned away the Protospatharius' Overwatch. League Hoplite 1 moved to 13,6, Argyraspides 2 and the Asklepian Medic to 2,6 and the Heliostat Battery to 1,8 on the left.

Very little hit. The Artillerists missed Argyraspides 1 with all three shots; Mandata Principum then activated Palatine Custos 1, which had nothing to do. The Protospatharius' Helios Pistol hit 3 of 3 and left Argyraspides 1 and Heron BURNED (1 damage, then 3 more from BURNED at the end of the phase). Heron and the Ikarus Skirmishers hit the Artillerists three times between them and every hit was saved.

The Protectores took the centre on OC 11 vs 9, 3 VP; the Mouseion held the left (OC 12 vs 0) and the right (OC 10 vs 0), 4 VP. FORLORN HOPE paid 2 for the Medic and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3. The Protectores' BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the centre taken and DEEP REACH 3. Pietas +2, Tier III. 17-10.

The Protectores named the Asklepian Medic for FORLORN HOPE again. Both spent 2 CP on Double Time: the Mouseion on League Hoplite 2 (it put the move in reach), the Protectores on Palatine Custos 1 (it bought nothing). Secondaries kept: DEEP REACH and OBJECTIVE RELAY.

Palatine Custos 1 and 2 charged Argyraspides 1 and Heron again, from 7,8 and 8,7. Argyraspides 1 failed its Fall Back test on a 1 and broke away in disorder to 10,8, another model lost. The Ikarus Skirmishers flew 2,7 to 7,7 onto the centre beside the Artillerists. League Hoplite 1 left the right objective, 13,6 to 10,6, and League Hoplite 2 ran to 5,5 with the Double Time.

The Palatine Artillerists rolled three 6s for 3 extra dice: 4 hits, 6 damage, Ikarus Skirmishers destroyed. That was the only attack of the round. Mandata Principum activated Palatine Custos 1 again, to no effect, and BURNED took 1 each off Heron and Argyraspides 1.

The Protectores held the centre on OC 11 vs 0, 3 VP; the Heliostat Battery held the left alone (OC 1 vs 0), 2 VP, and the right was empty. That empty objective paid the Protectores' BREAK THEIR HOLD 3, for an objective the Mouseion held at the start of the round. The Mouseion took FORLORN HOPE 2 and DEEP REACH 3 for the left. Pietas +4 for the kill and the centre, Tier IV. 24-16.

4.title: Back to the right, and past 30

feed.text: The Protectores named Heron of Alexandria for FORLORN HOPE and spent 2 CP on Double Time for Palatine Custos 2. The Mouseion spent 2 on Rally Cry for Argyraspides 1, which passed its Morale Test. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and STRONGPOINT.

Palatine Custos 1 charged Argyraspides 1, Heron and the Hephaestian Tripod at 9,8. Argyraspides 1 failed its Fall Back test a third time, broke away in disorder and lost another model, but landed at 12,6 on the right objective. The Tripod failed too and broke away to 11,9 for 1 True Damage. Palatine Custos 2's charge failed. League Hoplite 1 went forward to 7,5.

Exploding Shell gave the Artillerists SWEEP 2: 6 of 9 hits on League Hoplite 1, 8 damage (10 to 2). Palatine Custos 1 was activated by Mandata Principum a third time and did nothing. The Heliostat Battery hit through Go to Ground (1 CP) for 4 on the Artillerists (12 to 8), and League Hoplite 1 put 2 into Palatine Custos 2. Emperor's Finest changed nothing. Scions of Caesar then healed the Artillerists 3 and Custos 2 2.

The Protectores held the centre (OC 6 vs 0), 3 VP; the Mouseion held the left (OC 1 vs 0) and the right (OC 5 vs 0), 4 VP. FORLORN HOPE paid 2 for Heron and SECURE THE FLANKS 2 for Argyraspides 1 and Heron at 12,6; STRONGPOINT paid the Protectores 1. 32-20, the Mouseion past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Mouseion Contingent scored 15 VP from objectives, 6 from FORLORN HOPE and 11 from four secondaries: TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (3), TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (3), DEEP REACH (3) and SECURE THE FLANKS (2), one every round. Protectores Divini Lateris held the centre in Rounds 2 to 4 for 9 objective VP, took 7 from BREAK THEIR HOLD and 4 from DEEP REACH and STRONGPOINT. Neither flank objective ever had a Protectores unit on it.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Almost nothing was decided by damage. The Mouseion did 6 damage in four rounds (the Heliostat Battery 4, League Hoplite 1 2) and destroyed nothing. The Protectores' attacks did 15, 14 of it by the Palatine Artillerists, including the only kill, the Ikarus Skirmishers; the rest of the 30 damage the page counts for them came from BURNED (5) and from Mouseion units breaking away in disorder (10). The Mouseion's VP came from standing in the right places: Argyraspides 1 (8.0 VP) took the centre in Round 1 and ended on the right objective for SECURE THE FLANKS; the Heliostat Battery (6.4 VP, 4 objective VP hinged on it) held the left alone in Rounds 3 and 4; League Hoplite 1 (6.3 VP) held the right in Rounds 1 and 2. The Asklepian Medic scored 4.9 VP, almost all of it FORLORN HOPE, because the Protectores kept naming it.

Palatine Custos 1 and 2 are 140 RP, 56 percent of the Protectores army, and made no attack in four rounds. They made five charges between them, all at Argyraspides 1 and Heron of Alexandria. Argyraspides 1 fell back in each of Rounds 2, 3 and 4, failed the Fall Back test every time and broke away in disorder: 9 HP and three models in all, the Custos' whole damage. They and the Artillerists held the centre for 9 VP.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Protectores could not do

Be in more than one place. Four units against nine cannot hold three objectives: all four stood on or beside the centre from Round 2, so TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY was the Mouseion's for the taking and BREAK THEIR HOLD could score only where the Mouseion let an objective go. ASSASSINATION (a CHARACTER or MONSTER) never came close: Heron of Alexandria fell back from every charge and the Asklepian Medic was never in reach. OBJECTIVE RELAY needed a unit to move between two Objective Areas, and every Protectores unit was busy holding the centre.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 3, League Hoplite 1: it walked off the right objective (13,6 to 10,6) and then took no action. The Mouseion lost the 2 VP for the right, and the empty objective paid the Protectores' BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 (the record gives that 3 to no unit). A 5 VP swing for a move that bought nothing.
  • Round 3, Ikarus Skirmishers: they flew onto the centre next to the Palatine Artillerists and were shot dead, and the kill lifted the Protectores' Pietas to Tier IV.
  • FORLORN HOPE picks: the Protectores' AI named the Asklepian Medic in Rounds 2 and 3, on the left flank where no Protectores unit went, and Heron in Round 4 after Heron had fallen back from every charge. All three survived: 6 VP to the Mouseion.
  • Mandata Principum activated Palatine Custos 1 straight after the Artillerists in Rounds 2, 3 and 4; each time it ended its activation with nothing to do.
  • Commands bought for nothing: both Round 1 commands, the Protectores' Double Time in Rounds 3 and 4, and Emperor's Finest in Round 4.
  • Fall Back record: of its 11 decisions, 4 were real Fall Backs (Argyraspides 1 three times, the Hephaestian Tripod in Round 4). Most of the 7 holds are charge-planning probes with no enemy adjacent: the Tripod's risky holds in Rounds 2 and 3, and League Hoplite 2, Argyraspides 2 and the Heliostat Battery in Round 4.
  • Pietas: the round snapshots in the digest lag the ladder (they read 0, 4 and 6 at the end of Rounds 1 to 3); the log has the real totals, 4, 6 and 10.

The result is mostly the army list. Four elite units cannot hold three objectives or score cards against an army with nine units, however little damage the nine can do. The AI's mistakes ran both ways: League Hoplite 1's walk-off was a 5 VP swing to the Protectores, and the Protectores' AI named FORLORN HOPE units it never threatened.

closing: The Mouseion Contingent barely scratched the Protectores and still won by 12. It had more units than the Protectores had objectives to defend, it completed a card every round, and FORLORN HOPE paid on units the Protectores never went near. The Palatine Custos charged five times and never swung once.
